text: You see Katrina. She has a very pretty smile.
source_text: You see Katrina. She has a very pretty smile.

text: 你看到卡特里娜。笑起来非常可爱。她看着你，似乎有重要的事情要和你说。
source_text: 你看到卡特里娜。笑起来非常可爱。她看着你，似乎有重要的事情要和你说。

text: I am unarmed, please put your weapon away.
source_text: I am unarmed, please put your weapon away.

text: 我没有武器，因此请你把武器收起来。
source_text: 我没有武器，因此请你把武器收起来。

text: Hng!
source_text: Hng!

text: 呼！
source_text: 呼！

text: Why should I? This looks like a dangerous world.
source_text: Why should I? This looks like a dangerous world.

text: 为什么我要收起武器？这是个危险的世界。
source_text: 为什么我要收起武器？这是个危险的世界。

source_text: 为什么？

text: I'll assume that means yes.

text: Normally, I would agree with you.  It is very dangerous to travel# unarmed.  But this is Shady Sands, and we are a peaceful people.  There is# no need for weapons here.
source_text:
Normally, I would agree with you.  It is very dangerous to travel
# unarmed.  But this is Shady Sands, and we are a peaceful people.  There is
# no need for weapons here.

text: 通常来说，我认为你说的是对的。不带上武器在外面的世界游荡的确很危险。但这里是沙荫镇，我们都是爱好和平的人民。在这里不需要带武器。
source_text: 通常来说，我认为你说的是对的。不带上武器在外面的世界游荡的确很危险。但这里是沙荫镇，我们都是爱好和平的人民。在这里不需要带武器。

text: Ok.  Thanks.
source_text: Ok.  Thanks.

text: 好的。谢谢。
source_text: 好的。谢谢。

text: If you don't put your weapon away, I will not talk with you.  There# are many people like me.  You should only use force if the situation calls# for it.
source_text:
If you don't put your weapon away, I will not talk with you.  There
# are many people like me.  You should only use force if the situation calls
# for it.

text: 如果你不放下你的武器，我就不会和你谈话。这里许多人都是这样。你只有在情况危急时才能使用暴力。
source_text: 如果你不放下你的武器，我就不会和你谈话。这里许多人都是这样。你只有在情况危急时才能使用暴力。

text: Hmm, ok.
source_text: Hmm, ok.

text: 嗯，好吧。
source_text: 嗯，好吧。

text: Welcome to Shady Sands, traveler.  My name is Katrina.  My job is to# greet strangers and help them understand our village.  We find that# there are fewer problems if you listen to what I have to say.
source_text:
Welcome to Shady Sands, traveler.  My name is Katrina.  My job is to
# greet strangers and help them understand our village.  We find that
# there are fewer problems if you listen to what I have to say.

text: 旅行者，欢迎来到沙荫镇。我的名字是卡特里娜。我的工作是接待外来人，让他们理解我们村庄的制度。如果你仔细听我说的话，你一定不会遇到太多麻烦。
source_text: 旅行者，欢迎来到沙荫镇。我的名字是卡特里娜。我的工作是接待外来人，让他们理解我们村庄的制度。如果你仔细听我说的话，你一定不会遇到太多麻烦。

text: Wubba!
source_text: Wubba!

text: 呜叭叭！
source_text: 呜叭叭！

text: Tell me more about yourself.
source_text: Tell me more about yourself.

text: 告诉我关于你的事情。
source_text: 告诉我关于你的事情。

text: Please help me...
source_text: Please help me...

text: 请帮助我……
source_text: 请帮助我……

text: I'm looking for a water-chip.  Seen one?
source_text: I'm looking for a water-chip.  Seen one?

text: 我在找一个净水芯片。你看到过吗？
source_text: 我在找一个净水芯片。你看到过吗？

text: I need help finding Tandi.
source_text: I need help finding Tandi.

text: 我想找坦蒂，我需要帮助。
source_text: 我想找坦蒂，我需要帮助。

text: I'm dealing with your radscorpion problem.  Any clues?
source_text: I'm dealing with your radscorpion problem.  Any clues?

text: 我来解决你们的辐射蝎问题。有什么线索吗？
source_text: 我来解决你们的辐射蝎问题。有什么线索吗？

text: Thanks, maybe later.
source_text: Thanks, maybe later.

text: 谢谢，也许以后我会听。
source_text: 谢谢，也许以后我会听。

text: It is a pity that you are dimwitted.  We will have difficultly# understanding each other.  I hope the others in your Vault are not like you.
source_text:
It is a pity that you are dimwitted.  We will have difficultly
# understanding each other.  I hope the others in your Vault are not like you.

text: 很遗憾你不想听我的解释。这样我们会很难理解彼此的想法。我希望你的避难所中的其他人不是像你这样。
source_text: 很遗憾你不想听我的解释。这样我们会很难理解彼此的想法。我希望你的避难所中的其他人不是像你这样。

text: Wubba-val?
source_text: Wubba-val?

text: 呜叭叭－避难所？
source_text: 呜叭叭－避难所？

text: Yes, I can tell you are from a Vault.  You have that look about you.# I came from Vault-15, to the east.  But I had to leave my home and now# I live here.  Hopefully you will find what you are looking for, even# if it is just another place to live.  I hope that your Vault did not# kick you out due to your wits.  I do hope there is another reason.
source_text:
Yes, I can tell you are from a Vault.  You have that look about you.
# I came from Vault-15, to the east.  But I had to leave my home and now
# I live here.  Hopefully you will find what you are looking for, even
# if it is just another place to live.  I hope that your Vault did not
# kick you out due to your wits.  I do hope there is another reason.

text: 是的，我能看出来你是来自于一个避难所。深层次的印记是很难抹去的。我来自东边的15号避难所。但我不得不离开了自己的家园，而我现在生活在这里。希望你能够找到你要找的东西，即使你要找的只是另外一个容身之处。我希望你的避难所不是因为你的智力而把你赶了出来。我真的希望是因为别的什么原因。
source_text: 是的，我能看出来你是来自于一个避难所。深层次的印记是很难抹去的。我来自东边的15号避难所。但我不得不离开了自己的家园，而我现在生活在这里。希望你能够找到你要找的东西，即使你要找的只是另外一个容身之处。我希望你的避难所不是因为你的智力而把你赶了出来。我真的希望是因为别的什么原因。

text: Hng.
source_text: Hng.

text: 呼。
source_text: 呼。

text: You will need to find another way to get your answers, as you cannot# communicate well enough.  I hope that you do not hurt too many people# in your journey.  Please be nice to the people here, we mean you no harm.
source_text:
You will need to find another way to get your answers, as you cannot
# communicate well enough.  I hope that you do not hurt too many people
# in your journey.  Please be nice to the people here, we mean you no harm.

text: 你必须要找到另外一种方式来得到你的答案，因为你无法足够好地交流。我希望在你的旅途中你没有伤害太多的人。请对这边的居民好一点，我们对你没有恶意。
source_text: 你必须要找到另外一种方式来得到你的答案，因为你无法足够好地交流。我希望在你的旅途中你没有伤害太多的人。请对这边的居民好一点，我们对你没有恶意。

text: Ahhh.
source_text: Ahhh.

text: 啊啊啊。
source_text: 啊啊啊。

text: I would be happy to help you.  I myself was once like you.  Hopefully,# my knowledge will be useful.
source_text:
I would be happy to help you.  I myself was once like you.  Hopefully,
# my knowledge will be useful.

text: 我很高兴能帮助你。我也曾像你这样。很希望我的知识能派上用场。
source_text: 我很高兴能帮助你。我也曾像你这样。很希望我的知识能派上用场。

text: What should I do if I get hurt?
source_text: What should I do if I get hurt?

text: 如果我受伤了，该去哪里治疗？
source_text: 如果我受伤了，该去哪里治疗？

text: Where can I get some better equipment?
source_text: Where can I get some better equipment?

text: 我在哪里能找到好一点的装备？
source_text: 我在哪里能找到好一点的装备？

text: Tell me about this place.
source_text: Tell me about this place.

text: 给我介绍下这个地方。
source_text: 给我介绍下这个地方。

text: Tell me about the rest of the world.
source_text: Tell me about the rest of the world.

text: 给我介绍下这世界上的其他地方。
source_text: 给我介绍下这世界上的其他地方。

text: Tell me about yourself.
source_text: Tell me about yourself.

text: 给我介绍下你本人。
source_text: 给我介绍下你本人。

text: That's all for now, thanks.
source_text: That's all for now, thanks.

text: 先这样吧，谢谢。
source_text: 先这样吧，谢谢。

text: Well, if you can't get to a doctor, you will need to heal yourself.  Stimpaks# are a common healing item.  Use them on yourself to heal minor wounds.# First Aid is a slower method, but it is always available.  For major# wounds, like a broken leg, you will need to use Doctor skill.
source_text:
Well, if you can't get to a doctor, you will need to heal yourself.  Stimpaks
# are a common healing item.  Use them on yourself to heal minor wounds.
# First Aid is a slower method, but it is always available.  For major
# wounds, like a broken leg, you will need to use Doctor skill.

text: 如果你没办法找到一个医生，你就得自己治疗自己。针筒是一种最常见的治疗工具。把它使用在自己身上可以治疗轻伤。急救起作用比较慢，但你可以一直使用它而不会损失什么。对于重伤，例如说腿断了，你必须使用医疗技能。
source_text: 如果你没办法找到一个医生，你就得自己治疗自己。针筒是一种最常见的治疗工具。把它使用在自己身上可以治疗轻伤。急救起作用比较慢，但你可以一直使用它而不会损失什么。对于重伤，例如说腿断了，你必须使用医疗技能。

text: You will have to do like we do.  Scavenge it, or trade for it.  And if# you are attacked, your foes might provide equipment, if you live long# enough to loot them.  We are a peaceful community, so we mostly barter# or trade for the items we cannot produce.
source_text:
You will have to do like we do.  Scavenge it, or trade for it.  And if
# you are attacked, your foes might provide equipment, if you live long
# enough to loot them.  We are a peaceful community, so we mostly barter
# or trade for the items we cannot produce.

text: 你必须做和我们一样的事情。你需要某种东西，你要么抢夺，要么交易。假如你很能打，你可能会从你的敌人身上得到一些装备，前提是如果你能干掉他们的话。我们这里是一个和平的社区，所以对于那些我们自己无法生产的东西都是靠交易得来的。
source_text: 你必须做和我们一样的事情。你需要某种东西，你要么抢夺，要么交易。假如你很能打，你可能会从你的敌人身上得到一些装备，前提是如果你能干掉他们的话。我们这里是一个和平的社区，所以对于那些我们自己无法生产的东西都是靠交易得来的。

text: Tell me more about bartering.
source_text: Tell me more about bartering.

text: 告诉我关于交易的事。
source_text: 告诉我关于交易的事。

text: You are standing in Shady Sands.  We are but a small town in a large# world.  We just want to be left alone.  Besides some mutated animals# and other creatures of the desert, only the Raiders give us trouble.# Aradesh is our leader.  He is in the large central house, speak to him.
source_text:
You are standing in Shady Sands.  We are but a small town in a large
# world.  We just want to be left alone.  Besides some mutated animals
# and other creatures of the desert, only the Raiders give us trouble.
# Aradesh is our leader.  He is in the large central house, speak to him.

text: 你脚下的土地是沙荫镇。我们仅仅是这广大世界中的一个小镇。我们不想引起别人的注意，除了一些变种的动物和其他沙漠上的生物以外，只有歹徒给我们带来麻烦。亚拉德什是我们的镇长。他在城镇中间的大房子里，你可以和他谈。
source_text: 你脚下的土地是沙荫镇。我们仅仅是这广大世界中的一个小镇。我们不想引起别人的注意，除了一些变种的动物和其他沙漠上的生物以外，只有歹徒给我们带来麻烦。亚拉德什是我们的镇长。他在城镇中间的大房子里，你可以和他谈。

text: I know very little of the outside world.  I escaped from a Vault when# it was attacked.  Unfortunately, I was very hurt and do not remember# much of what happened.  But Dharma was watching over me, and I was# found by the people of Shady Sands.  I live here now.  Have you# spoken with Ian, yet?  He is a merchant guard who was hurt.  He is# recovering in the guardhouse over there. 【She points to the east】# He is more widely travelled than I.
source_text:
I know very little of the outside world.  I escaped from a Vault when
# it was attacked.  Unfortunately, I was very hurt and do not remember
# much of what happened.  But Dharma was watching over me, and I was
# found by the people of Shady Sands.  I live here now.  Have you
# spoken with Ian, yet?  He is a merchant guard who was hurt.  He is
# recovering in the guardhouse over there. 【She points to the east】
# He is more widely travelled than I.

text: 我对于外面的世界知道得相当少。我是在我的避难所被攻击时逃出来的。很不幸，我那时受了伤，所以不太记得究竟发生了什么。不过我活了下来，我被沙荫镇的人们救了。我现在住在这里。你和伊恩谈过吗？他是一个受了伤的商队守卫。他现在那边的警卫室疗伤。【她指向东边】他是个见多识广的人。
source_text: 我对于外面的世界知道得相当少。我是在我的避难所被攻击时逃出来的。很不幸，我那时受了伤，所以不太记得究竟发生了什么。不过我活了下来，我被沙荫镇的人们救了。我现在住在这里。你和伊恩谈过吗？他是一个受了伤的商队守卫。他现在那边的警卫室疗伤。【她指向东边】他是个见多识广的人。

text: My life was very boring.  I was raised in a Vault.  I lived there for# many years.  Unfortunately, we were crowded and life was very bad.# There was a schism, and many people left, taking with them the best# equipment.  Still, some of us tried to stay in the Vault.  But then we# were attacked.  I was hurt, and I ended up here.  Now I try# to help people . . .
source_text:
My life was very boring.  I was raised in a Vault.  I lived there for
# many years.  Unfortunately, we were crowded and life was very bad.
# There was a schism, and many people left, taking with them the best
# equipment.  Still, some of us tried to stay in the Vault.  But then we
# were attacked.  I was hurt, and I ended up here.  Now I try
# to help people . . .

text: 我的生活相当乏味。我成长在一座避难所中，并且在那里生活了许多年。不幸的是，我们的人口发生了爆炸，生存条件越来越差。于是人们发生了分裂，一部分人带走了最好的设备。我和部分人仍然试图留在避难所，但随后我们遭到了攻击。我受伤了，后来被这里的人所救。现在我也尝试着帮助别人……
source_text: 我的生活相当乏味。我成长在一座避难所中，并且在那里生活了许多年。不幸的是，我们的人口发生了爆炸，生存条件越来越差。于是人们发生了分裂，一部分人带走了最好的设备。我和部分人仍然试图留在避难所，但随后我们遭到了攻击。我受伤了，后来被这里的人所救。现在我也尝试着帮助别人……

text: Where was this Vault of yours?
source_text: Where was this Vault of yours?

text: 你的这一个避难所在哪里呢？
source_text: 你的这一个避难所在哪里呢？

text: Bartering is the exchange of goods. You give me some items,# and I give you items in trade. Since you initiated the barter,# I will let you pick and choose what you want. But the deal must be one that# I think I will like, so you will probably want to give me more valuable# goods that you don't need in exchange for less expensive things that you want.# And if you don't have enough items to trade, there are always caps.# Bottle caps are the only common money found out here. The caps are backed# by the merchants of the Hub, so you can trade them anywhere.
source_text:
Bartering is the exchange of goods. You give me some items,
# and I give you items in trade. Since you initiated the barter,
# I will let you pick and choose what you want. But the deal must be one that
# I think I will like, so you will probably want to give me more valuable
# goods that you don't need in exchange for less expensive things that you want.
# And if you don't have enough items to trade, there are always caps.
# Bottle caps are the only common money found out here. The caps are backed
# by the merchants of the Hub, so you can trade them anywhere.

text: 交易就是交换物品。你给我一些物品，我也给你一些物品作为交换。当你开始交易的时候，我会让你选择你要的东西。但交易必须是在我得到我想要的东西的时候才能成功，因此你也得把你手中更有价值但你并不需要的东西给我，以换取价值相对较低的东西。如果你的物品不够，我们还有瓶盖。瓶盖是这里的唯一通用货币。哈勃商人一直在大力推广瓶盖货币，所以你可以在任何地方用它进行交易。
source_text: 交易就是交换物品。你给我一些物品，我也给你一些物品作为交换。当你开始交易的时候，我会让你选择你要的东西。但交易必须是在我得到我想要的东西的时候才能成功，因此你也得把你手中更有价值但你并不需要的东西给我，以换取价值相对较低的东西。如果你的物品不够，我们还有瓶盖。瓶盖是这里的唯一通用货币。哈勃商人一直在大力推广瓶盖货币，所以你可以在任何地方用它进行交易。

text: It was Vault-15.  It is due east of here.  We tried to make contact# with some other Vaults, but we always failed.  I think it was the# raiders who attacked my fellow dwellers.  Be careful!
source_text:
It was Vault-15.  It is due east of here.  We tried to make contact
# with some other Vaults, but we always failed.  I think it was the
# raiders who attacked my fellow dwellers.  Be careful!

text: 那是15号避难所。它就在正东方。我们尝试联络其他的避难所，但总是失败。我认为是歹徒攻击了居住在那里的同胞。所以你要小心点！
source_text: 那是15号避难所。它就在正东方。我们尝试联络其他的避难所，但总是失败。我认为是歹徒攻击了居住在那里的同胞。所以你要小心点！

text: I hope you find her.  She is like a little sister to me.  I think it# was one of the raider groups who took her.  Find out as much information# about them as you can and equip yourself before you go after them. But don't# be so quick to fight, even they will sometimes listen to reason...
source_text:
I hope you find her.  She is like a little sister to me.  I think it
# was one of the raider groups who took her.  Find out as much information
# about them as you can and equip yourself before you go after them. But don't
